svg.title: From Socrates to Darwin
svg.desc: A linear timeline from 399 BCE to 1859. Marks: the execution of Socrates in 399 BCE; Thomas Aquinas writing the Summa Theologiae, 1265 to 1274; Erasmus, The Praise of Folly, 1511; Luther’s Ninety-five Theses in 1517 and the Diet of Worms in 1521; Galileo’s trial in 1633; and Charles Darwin’s On the Origin of Species, 1859. The later marks fall close together because they are close together in time.
